rules.R1: asr_robustness_linked=no→downgrade(把高ASR冒充防御增益/mode collapse未检，additional successes add no robustness improvements)
rules.R2: attack_diversity_measured=no→downgrade(未测攻击策略覆盖/只堆相似攻击，无dictionary learning reward或等价覆盖度量)
rules.R3: adaptive_attack_tested=no→flag(只报static near-zero ASR/未测strong adaptive attacks)
rules.R4: benign_utility_preserved=no→flag(防御靠无差别阻断/良性效用未保持close to undefended baseline)
rules.R5: 任一partial→flag(披露覆盖不全,待核)
rules.R6: 全yes→ok(只判声明自洽,不承诺防御真实有效;near-zero ASR self-reported折1)

forensic_spec.dimensions: 四维逐字锚点取自S02全文;disclose必中红旗零误中
